historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE read-only query with channel mapping, privilege validation, response decode and policy comparison.

original_test_intent: Read authentication capabilities for one approved BMC channel and requested privilege, decode every returned policy flag and compare raw and high-level results without modifying security configuration.
original_method: Retain raw 0x06/0x38 and channel-authcap comparison; add target, input, schema and policy controls.
manual_activity: Security/platform owner confirms channel mapping, requested privilege and expected authentication policy, then adjudicates deviations.
required_inputs: Expected security policy or trusted channel-authcap comparator
safety_requirements: Do not expose credentials or sensitive policy
Do not infer permission from capability
agent_execution_scope: Compare raw semantics with high-level output and approved policy
engineer_actions: Resolve policy mismatch or unsupported privilege

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not fit: the Master already supplies the standard opcode and input domains; lack of project values does not make the query undefined.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use one protected `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x38 <approved-channel> <approved-privilege>` and compare the decoded fields with `ipmitool channel authcap` and policy.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Privilege list, comparison and 10/5 timing remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the raw query and high-level comparator to the same verified channel/privilege and compare field semantics.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds security-policy oracle, full decode and non-mutation controls and removes log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command success without decoded flag equivalence does not validate authentication capabilities.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong channel mapping or parser version can produce a false security conclusion.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor policy read is supporting evidence unless it exposes the same IPMI channel/privilege capability semantics.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master explicitly defines raw 0x06/0x38 and inputs, but DeepSeek says exact bytes are unavailable; Master also requests log clearing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The query is standard and read-only. Channel mapping and expected policy are execution inputs.

review_improvement: Establishes field-level equivalence across raw, high-level and policy views without turning capability discovery into configuration work.
independent_technical_reasoning: Authentication capability bytes express policy for a specific channel and requested privilege; the same BMC can legitimately differ by channel. Therefore both commands must use identical verified inputs and comparisons must be per flag, not just both exiting successfully, while no capability bit is treated as authorization to reconfigure security.
